title: Streetlight Syndicate
description:
A casual incremental game with a complete story set in prohibition-era New York City.

• 20 rackets with unique upgrade paths and owner stories

• Over 5,000 words of character dialogue

• 10 ascension levels with narrative cutscenes

• Hitman battles with multiple weapon tiers

• Three gambling minigames that unlock as you rise

• Four permanent skill trees with over 40 upgrades to spend your Notoriety on

• Multiple endings based on your choices

• Idle progression with optional automation

You start with nothing but ambition and a few dollars in your pocket. A local boss takes notice and offers you a chance to prove yourself. What starts as small-time work grows into something much bigger.

Build Your Criminal Network

Invest in 20 illegal operations across the city. Run speakeasies, operate gambling halls, and control protection rackets that keep businesses "safe."

Each operation is run by someone with a story to tell. From Mae's underground speakeasy to Mickey's smuggling outfit at the docks, unlock their backstories with Influence and earn permanent bonuses along the way.

The Action

Track the Ace in 3 Card Monte. Watch the cards shuffle and pick the right one. Place your bets at the horse track where insider tips and fixed races tilt the odds your way. Rise high enough and you'll run your own Numbers Racket, skimming off the top while sweating the occasional bad beat.

The games aren't there to drain your wallet; they're there to fill it. Play smart and The Action becomes the fastest way to bankroll your next move.

Ascend the Hierarchy

When your empire hits its ceiling, it's time to Ascend. Reset your operations but keep your reputation, earning Notoriety to spend on permanent upgrades in the Ascension Market.

After each ascension, Don Salvatore Russo gives you his assessment. Are you building something that lasts, or leaving a trail of mistakes? Your choices determine his verdict and your fate.

Four skill trees to unlock: 

Composure - Delegate to your crew, automate collections, and spot profitable opportunities before anyone else does 

Connections - Build your network, protect your fortune, and keep the law paid and the competition nervous 

Capo - Master the violence when it's time for violence instead of words 

Chicanery - Work the angles. Unlock harder versions of the street games, tighten the odds in your favor, and expand your gambling operation

Fight Rival Hitmen

When diplomacy fails, bullets fly. Starting at Ascension 1, face off against rival hitmen in shootouts. Upgrade your arsenal from a Colt 1911 to the Thompson machine gun.

A Complete Story

This isn't an endless grind. Your criminal career has a beginning, middle, and end across 10 ascension levels. Your choices shape the story - build a lasting legacy or leave a trail of betrayal.

The city is waiting.
description_short: A casual incremental game set in 1920s prohibition-era New York. Run 20 rackets, gamble at The Action, fight rival hitmen, and ascend the ranks of organized crime. A complete story with multiple endings.
